blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 NAGOYA – Tenny Madis bowed out of the women’s tennis singles event at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 on Sunday. Madis fell to hometown bet and seventh seed Himeno Sakatsume in straight sets, 1-6, 0-6, on center court at Higashiyama Park Tennis Center to begin Philippine tennis’ bid. The World No. 119 Sakatsume proved too much for Madis as the Japanese star dictated the pace from the get-go.
